headline: Mooring and Farranac Flare as Expanse Falls Quiet
war_summary: Since the midday edition, Mooring County has quickened with five changes in two hours and twenty-three in the day about Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut, the tally now standing nine Warden to three Colonial with more than eight thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden losses in the day and enlistments still accelerating, latest filed at 14:16. Farranac Coast has rekindled at the hour with three changes in two hours and twelve in the day about Transient Valley and The Bone Haft, latest at 15:15, now holding eleven Colonial. Stlican Shelf remains active with two changes in two hours about Fort Hoarfrost on a five-to-four Warden lead and casualty rates accelerating on both sides. The Weathered Expanse, by contrast, has gone quiet in the last two hours since the 12:10 filing, though thirty-two day changes about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk keep it on the watch list at six to three. Stonecradle stays silent since 09:16 despite seventeen day changes, while Callahans Passage reports heavy day losses at nearly six thousand Colonial and four thousand Warden with quickened rates but no recorded flip.
